visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A black and white line engraving depicting a solemn outdoor funeral or burial scene. A group of people are gathered in an open field. In the center, a figure in 18th-century attire stands reading from an open book. Behind them, several figures are carrying a shrouded body on a stretcher or bier. In the foreground, a man in buckskin clothing stands with his back to the viewer, holding a long rifle, while another man in a frock coat and breeches stands to the left, also facing away from the viewer, holding a hat. Other figures, including some appearing to be Indigenous people, stand in the background.
